heroHeadline: Mass Housing Protests Sweep Spain as Tens of Thousands Take to the Streets
heroSubtitle: Protesters marched in Madrid, Barcelona, and other major cities under the slogan 'This can't go on', demanding government action on the housing crisis after reform legislation stalled — adding social pressure to an already fraught debate over migration and integration.
